utility.name: capa
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Installs Mandiant's capa, which identifies the capabilities of a PE, ELF or .NET executable or shellcode (for example "create TCP socket" or "persist via cron") using a built-in rule set, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and MBC. Installs the pinned standalone release binary, verified against its SHA-256.
